images.caption: Four planks occupy the personal crafting grid and produce a crafting table.
strengths: Input-to-output relation is spatial and inspectable.
Clearing affects the local recipe, not a broad activity setup.
weaknesses: Spatial arrangements are a learned game mechanic.
The output icon alone does not explain consumption across input devices.
application: Present ingredients, result and one craft action together.
Do not import arrangement puzzles unless placement is an intended mechanic.

strengths: Opened object and carried goods are continuously visible.
